text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with 14 field reps for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**The wins:**
- Reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week previously spent on CRM updates.
- Follow-up emails went out same-day instead of 2–3 days later.
- Managers could finally coach from real conversations, not rep summaries.

**The surprises:**
- Customers cared more about consent than features. Asking upfront built trust.
- Summaries were only as good as the questions reps asked.
- Adoption jumped once we shared top-performing call clips internally.

**The misses:**
- Accuracy dipped in noisy plant and warehouse visits.
- Some reps feared surveillance until we clarified the purpose.

Our takeaway: AI doesn't replace judgment. It gives reps time back to use it.

What did your team learn from your first AI pilot?
